value: This resource presents a concise, chronological timeline detailing major milestones in artificial intelligence, with a specific emphasis on Western language and multimodal models, largely excluding text-to-image generation. It traces developments from Alan Turing's foundational concepts in 1947 through to projected advancements in 2025, highlighting key releases such as the OpenAI GPT series. Designed as a selective overview of critical AI progress, it complements a more comprehensive 'Models Table' for detailed insights.
